source_text: Iesus extendit manum cum contum; non contrahit donec deleantur. Oratio et intentio mentis usque ad victoriae finem. Incendit Gai — chaos mentis malitiae. Gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Jesus stretches hand with spear; not he-draws-back until they-are-destroyed. Prayer and intention of-mind until of-victory end. He-burns Ai — chaos of-mind of-malice. Glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus stretches out the spear and does not draw it back until Ai is destroyed >> Bible:Joshua 8:18-26]]. Prayer and mind’s intent hold to victory’s end. He burns Ai — chaos of malice in the mind. Glory forever. Amen.
